EXIT-TIMING INTERPRETATION: the card says take-profit 'exit at next bar's close after cci >= 0'. Realized as: detect CCI(shift1) >= 0 on the just-closed D1 bar in AdvanceDaily, then close at the next session open (first tick of the new D1 bar) -- which equals the signal bar's CLOSE on gapless .DWX index CFDs (open[0]==close[1]). This keeps exit execution symmetric with the entry convention ('enter long at next session open') and is the most-literal framework realization. If the reviewer prefers a strict additional +1-bar delay (exit at the bar AFTER the cci>=0 bar's close), it is a one-line latch change.

CHAOS-FILTER PERCENTILE SEMANTICS: 'skip if ATR(14)/close is in the top 1st percentile over the trailing 252 bars' is implemented as: maintain a 252-bar ring of ATR/close ratios (includes the current closed bar), and block a new entry when the current ratio >= the (1 - vol_top_pctile/100) = 0.99 quantile of that window (top ~2-3 of 252 samples). The filter is inactive until the ring holds a full 252 samples (cannot rank a partial window). Computed once per new D1 bar and cached (g_chaos_block); the per-tick path only reads the cached bool. strategy_vol_lookback (252) and strategy_vol_top_pctile (1.0) are inputs.
